art_direction: 深青短发的成年旅行者在蓝白电车旁低头确认路线，海风与晴空形成清爽竖屏构图。
composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 27-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Give her vivid blue-gray almond eyes, gently defined cheekbones, and a small amused smile. Her deep teal bob moves slightly in the sea breeze. Dress her in an opaque ivory sleeveless linen blouse, loose terracotta ankle trousers, and simple white canvas shoes; a small woven crossbody bag rests at her side. She stands beside a quiet coastal tram stop, turning a neatly folded paper map between both hands close to her waist. A blue-and-white tram recedes behind her without passengers in view. Pale stucco walls, a slender tram cable, and a distant strip of turquoise water establish the location. Choose clean cyan, warm coral, and cream, with soft morning shadows and delicate reflected ocean light. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory heroine-v2-ninety/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Compressed contact sheet inspected: teal bob with map at tram, chestnut braid checking ticket at alpine station, lilac hair at lavender field, dark bob with sketchbook on canal bridge, copper ponytail at desert botanical walk, and indigo-haired seated traveler studying printed photograph. Adult design, coherent natural hands, secure opaque summer attire, scenic variety and clean upper areas. No extra people or unwanted text.
